page_note: Page is dominated by cosmological-anthropogonic teaching: Sin/Hyle bearing fruits, archons fashioning Adam and Eve after the image of the Exalted One, and a second teaching unit on the molder placing sense-faculties/operations and inner 'storehouses, granaries, caverns' in the human plasma. Two clear dialogue-frame seams ('Once again the Illuminator said' at i=5 and i=20) wrap substrate teaching — extract teaching, classify as mixed. Strong editorial fatigue signature confirmed: a hortatory recap unit at i=16-19 ('Behold, I have taught you concerning this word: how the archons molded Adam and Eve...') sits between the two teaching blocks — pure pastoral recapitulation. The substrate beneath is rich anthropogonic correspondential teaching (planting/fruits, image of the Ambassador/Exalted One, sense-organs ↔ inner storehouses).
